notes.title: Update – Version 1.7.6
notes.notes:
This update consists of gameplay changes and tweaks to address its criticisms and improve intuitiveness. A list of the changes made can be found below.

- Changes to the player character’s platforming abilities
- Changes to several screens/rooms
- Changes to enemy AI
- Minor changes to player character’s running animation
- Minor changes to background graphics
- Minor changes to dialogue

Thank you for all of the support and patience. Also, stay safe.

P.S.
It’s possible that you may need to reinstall/re-download this game (4MB download) to receive this update.

notes.title: Achievements Added!
notes.notes:
Achievements have been applied in this update as well as other changes that I have listed below:

-Adjustments to the player character's movement, combat, and platforming abilities
-Adjustments to enemies’ AI
-Changes to in-game menus

notes.title: Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin - Vote on Greenlight!
notes.notes:
UPDATE:

Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin had been Greenlit and is currently available on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/454130/

My latest game, entitled Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin, is currently on Greenlight for voting. Please do take a look at it through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=554088148]this link[/url].

Nil-Ninjahtic: Ronin is a pseudo 8-bit action platformer. It combines much of the gameplay aspects of the previous titles in the series in a manner that differentiates it from its predecessors, minding the feedback received on those titles through Steam reviews, forum posts, and Let's Play videos.
